summary: Meadow Commerce is a 72,000 SF fictional industrial property, 100% occupied (3/3 suites) with monthly base rent of $62,000 as of 2026-08-31. T12 (Sep-2025 to Aug-2026) EGI is $882,000, operating expenses $212,400, NOI before reserves $669,600, reserves $14,400, and NCF $655,200. The September 2026 underwriting scenario sets GPR at $756,000 with 3% combined revenue loss and $162,000 other income; after normalized expenses (including a 3% of EGI management minimum) and $0.20/SF reserves, UW NOI before reserves is $666,860 and UW NCF is $652,460. Indicative value at a 6.50% cap is $10.26MM. Sizing at the 6.50% underwriting rate (30-year amortization) yields constraints: LTV $6.156MM, DSCR $6.614MM, and Debt Yield $6.868MM; the binding maximum is $6.156MM (LTV). At this loan, sizing ADS is ~$467.1k (DSCR ≈ 1.40x) while contractual year-1 IO debt service at 6.10% is ~$375.5k. Net cash to the borrower after 1% origination and $55k fixed closing costs versus a $3.60MM payoff is approximately $2.44MM. Under the combined downside (EGI −5% and sizing rate +100 bps; cap rate unchanged), stressed NOI before reserves is ~$622.6k and the maximum loan tightens to ~$5.58MM (DSCR-constrained). Suite 101’s executed lease confirms $12,800/month rent, expiry 2028-08-31, and a $25,600 security deposit; no renewal exercise notice is in the packet. Verified renewal insurance premium remains unknown.
